text:
DNS::type
Description
This iRules command gets or sets the resource record type field
Note: This command functions only in the context of LTM iRules and
requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled as part of GTM or the
DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
type
<
rr_obj
>
[
value
]
DNS::type <rr_obj> [value]
Gets or sets the resource record type field (e.g. A, AAAA, MX, NPTR,
etc)
Examples
Remove SOA records from section
when
DNS_RESPONSE
{
set
rrs
[
DNS
::
answer
]
foreach
rr
$rrs
{
if
{
[
DNS
::
type
$rr
]
==
"SOA"
}
{
DNS
::
answer
remove
$rr
}
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
